chrome.extDescription: Save the page you are on to Flama, and keep your workspace one click away.
chrome.toastFailed: Flama could not save this page

signIn.title: Sign in to Flama
signIn.description: Use your Flama account to save pages and reach your workspace from any tab.

page.title: This page
page.restricted: Flama cannot read this page. Chrome keeps its own pages and the Web Store off limits to every extension.
page.failed: Flama could not read this page. Reload it and try again.
page.shortcutHint: Press {{shortcut}} on any page to save it.

clips.title: Saved pages
clips.emptyDescription: Press {{shortcut}} on any page, or right-click a selection, and it lands here.
clips.emptyDescriptionNoShortcut: Right-click a page or a selection, and it lands here.
clips.localNote: Saved pages stay in this browser.

options.title: Settings
options.description: How Flama behaves in this browser.
options.shortcutsDescription: Open Flama with <kbd>{{open}}</kbd> and save the current page with <kbd>{{save}}</kbd>.
options.privacyDescription: Flama reads a page only when you ask it to, from the toolbar, the right-click menu or a shortcut, and only that page. It asks Chrome for access to no website.
